title.zh: Securitize Brings Nvidia, Apple and Amazon Onchain With Tokenized Stocks on Solana
title.en: Securitize Brings Nvidia, Apple and Amazon Onchain With Tokenized Stocks on Solana

current_state.zh: Securitize has launched tokenized versions of major US equities including Nvidia, Apple and Amazon on the Solana blockchain, extending real-world-asset tokenization to blue-chip stocks.
